page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top with page number at top right; no margin notes.

p.i: diatur: Celeris, quòd qua fertur celeritate, ue hementer impellat: Alti, quòd veluti subeat ac intret: Conuulsiui, quòd ob tensionem & grè arteria moueatur: Vibrati, quòd ob vibrationem tensionis, simul duritiei & celeris occursus speciem præbeat.

main_text.p: Pleni simul & uacui, Dignotiones nunc sileo, quòd tales non agno scere videatur Galenus, tanquam tactui nõ subiectos.

Rhythmus dignoscitur, Moderata digitorum applicatione, ne quid externi interpellent motus: dignosciturque in solis vehementissimis pulsibus: & si qualitatem motus distensionis contuleris, cũ qualitate motus contractionis: id quod patet ex tabula, in qua sunt sex concursuum formæ.
main_text.head: DE CAVSIS PVLSVVM.

page.notes: The chapter initial "G" is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to "Generatrices" / "Alteratrices" as printed. The heading "DE CAVSIS PVLSVVM." is set across two lines with a hyphen ("PVL-" / "suum"). Section initial letters are approximated.
